title: Logical Replication
description: Use logical replication and subscriptions for selective data.

data.title: Publication
data.code:
CREATE PUBLICATION user_changes FOR TABLE users, orders
  WITH (publish = 'insert, update, delete');

data.title: Subscription
data.code:
CREATE SUBSCRIPTION user_sync
  CONNECTION 'host=primary dbname=appdb user=replicator password=secret' 
  PUBLICATION user_changes
  WITH (copy_data = false, create_slot = true);

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use logical replication for CDC and multi-master with BDR.
